name: multimedia-upload-search
description: MediaVault — secure multimedia upload, preview and ranked search (React + Redux Toolkit + TanStack Query + Tailwind, Express 5 + MongoDB + Cloudinary + Socket.IO)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev:memory" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
